messages.body: Good morning ma, tomatoes are cheaper today. ₦28,000 a basket.
Bring 4 baskets and 2 bags of tatashe please.
No problem. My boy will be there before 9.

Today's prices, ma. Tell me what you want before 2pm and my boy brings it tomorrow morning.
1. Tomatoes (big basket) ₦28,000
2. Tomatoes (small basket) ₦15,000
3. Tatashe ₦22,000 a bag
4. Rodo ₦18,000 a bag
5. Onions ₦35,000 a bag
6. Ugu, fresh this morning ₦1,500 a bunch
7. Ewedu ₦800 a bunch
8. Garden eggs ₦6,000 a basket
9. Okra ₦9,000 a basket
10. Plantain ₦12,000 a bunch
11. Yams ₦4,500 a tuber
12. Irish potatoes ₦20,000 a bag
13. Ginger ₦7,000 a bag
14. Garlic ₦9,500 a bag
15. Pepper (shombo) ₦16,000 a bag
16. Carrots ₦11,000 a bag
17. Cabbage ₦3,500 each
18. Cucumber ₦8,000 a basket
19. Lettuce ₦2,000 a head
Call me if you want to come and see them yourself.
